title: Model asset lock
description: The JSON asset lock of Starlings.Acquisition (ModelAssetLock.ToJson, Parse and Load), versions 1 to 3. This is the interchange format for locks between Starling and its consumers. Version 1: Hub-layout files only. Version 2 adds a per-file explicit source (url). Version 3 adds display_name and hosting. A writer uses the lowest version that holds the lock; a reader of version N rejects higher versions and rejects fields of a higher version.

name.description: Short identifier used in messages and tool commands.

display_name.description: Version 3: optional name for people. Not used for any path.

hosting.description: Version 3: the Hub repository and commit that hold the bytes of files without a url. repository and revision stay the identity of the model and key the cache directory.

repository.description: Hub repository id, owner/name, each part letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.', not '.' or '..'.

commitSha.description: Full 40-character lowercase commit SHA. Branch and tag names are rejected.

path.description: Relative path with forward slashes; no empty, '.', '..' or control-character segment, no backslash or colon.

url.description: Version 2 and later: explicit https download address, without user information or fragment.
